name: Rosewood Little Dix Bay
positioning: Beach resort on Virgin Gorda in the British Virgin Islands, considered one of the first eco-resorts, with garden cottages set just steps from the beach
best_for: Travelers who want beach time, snorkeling and tennis on Virgin Gorda
Families with children ages 4 to 12, who can join the complimentary Rosewood Explorers program

facts.text: The property is considered one of the first eco-resorts and has kept that commitment throughout its 60-year history.
The rooms are airy cottages set among gardens just steps from the beach.
The One-Bedroom Pool Suite has its own pool, ocean views and a furnished patio.
Sugar Mill serves Caribbean cuisine in a beachfront setting.
Reef House, steps from the sand, uses fresh local produce from the resort's own farm.
The Chef's Table at Sugar Mill is a ten-course menu inspired by the Caribbean and Virgin Gorda.
Sense, A Rosewood Spa overlooks the Sir Francis Drake Channel from a cliffside setting.
Beach drops give guests a few hours of sunbathing, exploring and snorkeling on a secluded beach.
The resort has six tennis courts and two pickleball courts.
The Rosewood Explorers program for children ages 4 to 12 is complimentary.
Each guest's personal butler is on call at any time of day or night.
The resort is a twelve-minute drive from Baths National Park.

highlights.text: The Tree House Suites honor the resort's original tree houses and have wraparound beach views and indoor-outdoor rain showers.
The Rum Room is an open-air bar with over 100 varieties of rum from around the world.
Guests can book a tour of the resort's farm, where organic mangos, cauliflower, lemongrass and okra are grown.
The Sense Spa has an infinity pool perched on a cliff with views of the Sir Francis Drake Channel.
Through a partnership with the Association of Reef Keepers, guests can join sea turtle tagging and coral restoration experiences.

considerations.text: Most guests arrive by catamaran from Tortola at the resort's private dock.
There are no room keys or locks on the doors.

sources.title: Rosewood Little Dix Bay review - Condé Nast Traveler
